title: Agent Comparison Benchmark Run Manifest v0.2
description: Pins everything held fixed for one benchmark run so a difference in results can be attributed to exactly ONE varying axis (agent_variant_id or model_config_id), never both at once -- same purpose experiment-run.schema.json serves for retrieval experiments (domain/interfaces/experiment-run.schema.json), scoped instead to Agent x Model comparison. Turn P1.1 adds reproducibility pins (agent_variant_revision, model_config_sha256, prompt_template_id/sha256, dataset_sha256, temperature, max_output_tokens, determinism, cache_policy, code_revision, fallback_scoring_policy) so a later audit can confirm exactly what produced a given telemetry set without re-reading raw prompts/responses -- this manifest never stores a raw prompt or a raw model response; only hashes/ids of them.

agent_variant_revision.description: Identifies exactly which version of the AgentFlow implementation produced this run -- e.g. a git revision (see code_revision) or a variant-local semantic version. Two runs with the same agent_variant_id but a different agent_variant_revision are NOT directly comparable as "the same Agent design".

model_config_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonicalized ModelConfig object (domain/agent-comparison/reproducibility.mjs's computeModelConfigSha256). ModelConfig never contains the API key itself (only its env var name), so this is safe to record and never leaks a secret.

prompt_template_id.description: Stable id of the fixed instructional prompt template the Agent variant used to ask the model for an answer (e.g. structured-first-agent.mjs's ANSWER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ID). null only for a variant/run that never calls a model at all.

prompt_template_sha256.description: sha256 of the FIXED template text only (not of any per-question filled prompt, which is never stored here or anywhere as Gold/reference data).

role.description: SMOKE_REGRESSION is Seed 25's role (wiring/regression only, not Gold -- see domain/evaluation/asset-audit.v1.json). This field records the role a dataset was actually used under for THIS run; it does not itself authorize an official DEV/HOLDOUT run.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonicalized (question_id, question) list actually run (domain/agent-comparison/reproducibility.mjs's computeDatasetSha256). Pins WHICH questions ran without storing expected answers/Gold here.

seed.description: A provider-supported sampling seed, if the model config set one. null when the provider has no seed concept or none was set.

provider_deterministic_mode.description: Free-text name of whatever provider-specific deterministic/reproducible-output setting was requested (e.g. "temperature=0", a provider's own "deterministic" flag name), or null if none is supported/requested.

cache_policy.description: Free-text description of prompt/response caching in effect for this run (e.g. "NONE", "PROVIDER_PROMPT_CACHE_DISABLED"). A cache hit can change latency/cost without changing the model's own quality -- this pin lets a later comparison account for that.

code_revision.description: git revision (optionally suffixed "-dirty") of the working tree that produced this run (domain/agent-comparison/reproducibility.mjs's detectCodeRevision), or "unknown" if it could not be determined. Never blocks a run from completing.

fallback_scoring_policy.description: Fixed, documented statement of how fallback-substituted answers (model_fallback_used=true telemetry rows) are treated in scoring for this run -- e.g. "EXCLUDE_FALLBACK_FROM_MODEL_SCORING". Recorded once per run so a later comparison never has to guess whether fallback rows were already filtered.
